name: Block Content Type Visibility
description: Adds Show/Hide radio buttons to Drupal core's node content-type block-visibility condition, replacing the confusing "Negate the condition" checkbox.
project_description: Block Content Type Visibility is a small UX-improvement module for Drupal core's block placement UI. It does NOT add a new condition plugin of its own: it relies on core Node's built-in "Content types" (entity_bundle:node) block-visibility condition, and only alters the block configuration form to add a friendly "Visibility mode" radio set (Show for the selected content types / Hide for the selected content types) that maps onto the condition's existing negate boolean. A custom submit handler converts the chosen radio back to negate (show=0, hide=1) and hides core's raw "Negate the condition" checkbox. Logic lives in the OOP Hook class src/Hook/BlockContentTypeVisibilityHooks.php (via #[Hook('form_block_form_alter')]), with the legacy .module procedural hook delegating to it on Drupal < 11.1. It affects only which blocks render on a page (presentation); it is not access control and does not protect the underlying block content.
